$comment: AFD's half of the Factory Gateway's process manifest (the proposal's 'Keeping the process current'); Lushly keeps its own half in Docs/operations/factory-gateway/process.json. scripts/check-process.mjs reads it in the pre-push hook and pnpm check: each milestone's files must be tracked, and once its 'landed' is true each must name its commands; the door check always runs over door.scope. Paths are relative to this repository's root.

door.$comment: GitHub writes the gateway serves (issue-claim, issue-release, issue-label, issue-set, issue-comment, issue-create, pr-open, verification-record, pr-merge, pr-revert, variable-set; git push, which branch-push serves, is left to the hooks of G1 and G5). scripts/check-process.mjs holds the patterns that find them and refuses them in this repository's door.scope: instruction files, skills, runbooks, scripts (text and argument lists), hooks, MCP configuration and the agent tooling's code, comments aside. Out of scope (door.scope does not reach them): GitHub Actions workflows and Alfred, which write as GITHUB_TOKEN or their own App, not as an agent. door.exclude names, with a reason, what the scope reaches but the door does not read: tests, and the gateway itself, which is the door. Each allowed file may keep its writes until the named milestone lands; after that, or once it holds none or is gone, the check fails on it. Each names why and the issue that removes it.

exclude.reason: Tests hold writes as the inputs and fixtures of the code they test, run against fakes.
The gateway is the door: its code makes the writes the others call it for.

allow.reason: Tells triage to set an epic's type and attach or detach its sub-issues with gh api graphql (addSubIssue, removeSubIssue, updateIssueIssueType); G1's issue-create (type, parent) and issue-set replace them for the foreman and owner (#2515), but a session that opens an epic keeps gh until G5, when /session gains its other writes.
Claims and releases issues with gh label edits and comments; G1's issue-claim and issue-release replace them.
The factory's GitHub port writes through gh until G1 routes it through the gateway.
Labels and comments on issues with gh until G1's issue-label and issue-comment.
Interactive sessions open, edit and merge their own pull requests with gh until G5 puts sessions through the door.
Interactive sessions close out their own pull requests and issues with gh until G5.
Comments on the sweep's trend issue (gh issue comment, under --record) from an interactive session until G5.
The source of the seeded bloat sweeper: comments on the sweep's trend issue (gh issue comment, under --record) from an interactive session until G5.
Botcore's undo prints gh issue commands that reverse a session's own writes until G5.
